$comment: Known incompatibilities between captured releases and current source, found by the compatibility matrix (docs/tactical/359-mixed-version-compatibility-matrix.md). Tests accept exactly these items for these captures and fail on anything else. Each entry needs a maintainer decision: fix, or accept until the releases leave the support window.

breaks.impact: Tracker timing moved from ages to instants anchored on UpdateBatch.server_now_millis in 0.3.1. Current clients default server_now_millis and fill the instants with null for these hosts (tracker timing shows as unknown). Extension 1.1.3 requires the age fields and rejects current hosts' tracker views.

Current clients send download_all_pending_add (Download all on a pending add) to hosts that do not know it; those hosts close the connection. Released hosts advertise no capabilities, so these cannot be told apart from 0.3.1.
Android 1.0.29 ignores disable_future, so "don't ask again" is not saved there.
The request-level form of the two entries above.
